question: Dhalo is a folk dance of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhalo** is a traditional folk dance of **Goa**, which is performed by women in a group during the **monsoon season.**
 
• The dance involves** forming a circle** and **moving rhythmically** to the beats of the dhol and other percussion instruments.
 
• Goa, on the other hand, has a unique blend of **Portuguese and Indian cultures**, which is reflected in its music and dance forms. 
 
• Apart from Dhalo, the state is also known for its popular folk dance forms such as **Fugdi, Dekhni, and Corredinho.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu **is known for its classical dance form **Bharatanatyam**.

 
 
• However, the state also has several folk dances such as **Karagattam, Kavadi, and Mayilattam.**
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is home to several folk dance forms such as **Charkula, Rasiya, and Nautanki,** among others.
 
 
• The state is also known for its classical dance form **Kathak.**
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has a rich tradition of folk dances such as **Gaur, Tertali, and Matki**, among others.
 
 
• Madhya Pradesh is known for **Tansen**, a famous musician and poet who was born in the state
